doc.title: Joseph Rene and Edna Kelly Interview, 1969-12-15

title: Chris Kelly's country origins, Army draft and marriage; closing
summary: Edna says Chris worked the fields, was drafted, and married her after the Army. The interview closes.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Yeah. And, um, did he ever talk about, he was from down the river with him? Yeah. He originally came from. G. Ranch. G. Ranch, yes. Uh, did he ever talk about, um, about his life down there at all? I mean, do you know anything about him?

Yeah, he was working the field. Mm-hmm. Working the field. Then he got, I'll tell you, he got a lot of people. He got, I'll tell you, picked up the piece of stuff, blowing and saying stuff, play those days, and finally he came up here and drafted for the Army. They drafted him to the Army after he got to New Orleans, is it? I guess so. Yeah. Yeah. Yes. And when he came from the Army, he drafted me. He drafted me. That's when you married him, was it?
Yes. Was it fairly soon after you got back from the Army? Huh? Was it fairly soon after? Not too long. Five, a few months, I guess. Hmm.
Hmm. Hmm. Hmm. Hmm. Hmm. I can't remember anything more. I can't remember. Okay. Well, that's nearly the whole of that. Just a whole thing right there.
I tell you, part, best part of it right there.
The best part of it right there.
